title: a cancelled task's async destroy is awaited after cancel() returns, and its settlement follows that cleanup
purpose: Run the program and observe the order of its output.

stdout.text:
main: cancel returned
main: release set
lease: returned
main: holder -1

provenance.origin: authored for #340; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #340 with #154: the shielded async destroy of the cancelled task runs when main suspends; the task settles as cancelled after the destroy has finished.
